coordinateSpace: EPSG:4326; manually inferred broad street-fabric outlines, not exact OSM way concatenations

areas.name: Bethlen Gábor-lakótelep
areas.note: Broad estate/block group beside Országút and Bethlen Gábor streets. Internal west/east separators are inferred from the actual dense street-block fabric; the established inventory also records Dominó házak as a source name.

areas.name: Duránda
areas.note: The municipal2016ITS p89 places Duranda mainly north of Csárda utca; pp151–152 identify the two northern segregation areas as Duranda. The outline is a broad inhabited street-fabric estimate with inferred garden-edge joins; statistical cell fills are not relabelled as a whole quarter.

areas.name: Kakastánc
areas.note: Northern residential grid around the named Kakastánc street, retaining the long blocks up to the Sárhegy/Diósmalom-side outer street edge. Inferred join towards neighbouring Diósmalom/Felsőváros; intentional overlap with larger northern units.

areas.name: Mátrai úti lakótelep
areas.note: Municipal2016ITS p84 describes the Mátrai úti estate as four-storey blocks and three ten-storey buildings in the northern part of the eastern quarter. Broad actual street-block footprint between Mátrai út and the railway-side edge; small internal separators inferred.

areas.name: Nyolcvanas lakótelep
areas.note: Municipal2016ITS pp83–84 and96–99 describe the broad Nyolcvanas estate and its internal Hertelendy/Verseny/Esze Tamás street context. This estimate follows that multi-block fabric rather than one small point-selected block; joins at the garden-city fringe are inferred.

areas.name: Pesti úti lakótelep
areas.note: The municipal2016ITS p83 explicitly describes four Pesti úti estate blocks. This broad street/building-zone estimate covers their locality and surrounding immediate land; approximate separators towards Ringsted and adjacent blocks do not assert cadastral or exact estate membership.

areas.name: Vásár tér
areas.note: Southwestern market-square/fringe land beside the actual Tó/Vásár/Püspöki approach pattern. The irregular outer land edge and separation from nearby open plots are manually inferred; broader usable neighbourhood envelope instead of water/building-only geometry.

areas.name: Észak-Kálváriapart
areas.note: Actual hillside road group around the northern Kálvária/Esthajnal/Alkony streets. The garden-edge and north/south hill separators are rough hand estimates; intentionally overlaps larger western/northern quarters.

areas.name: Északi városrész
areas.note: Municipal2016ITS pp17–20 identify the Northern quarter, and p28 shows the full northern setting beyond the clipped p19 overview. This is an explicitly estimated populated northern-city envelope using the stated southern roads and the actual northern road/grid and vineyard fringe. It excludes the long mountain corridor and separately named Mátrafüred; northern/eastern field-edge joins are inferred, not image-frame closure.

areas.name: Mátrafüred
areas.note: Broad populated Mátrafüred footprint follows the actual villa/street grid, school/tourism compounds, Parádi út corridor and stream/woodland transition. Municipal2016ITS pp22–23 and28 identify the settlement and its tourism setting. Irregular outer garden/forest joins are hand-inferred; the long southeastern rural ribbon and full mountain forest are not copied into the town estimate.

areas.name: Ipari park
areas.note: Broad actual industrial-compound and access-road corridor around Gábor Dénes/Kandó/Jedlik streets, constrained by Karácsondi út and the eastern canal/field transition. Source buildings and plots are retained as evidence, but adjoining industrial land is included so the estimate is usable for address matching. Fine property/company park membership and outer field joins remain uncertain.
